name: quant-backtest
instructions:
Run a reproducible, leakage-resistant backtest with point-in-time data, purged and embargoed validation, cost/impact realism, generated-code audit, deterministic replay, known-failure fixtures, and an explicit PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT-RUN verdict.

Capabilities:
- apply quant backtest methods within explicit quant boundaries
- audit data, code, configuration, validation, costs, execution assumptions, and failure modes
- produce and validate a quant artifact with evidence, provenance, hashes, and a bounded verdict

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/quant/quant-backtest/SKILL.md
handoff_description: Required manifests and hashes are recorded, point-in-time and leakage controls pass, validation and cost assumptions are evidenced, deterministic replay and known-failure fixtures are evaluated, and the verdict is PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT-RUN.
